title: Product launch
brief:
A product launch email for Orbit 2.0.

- Preview text: "Live previews, typed templates and one-click deploys."
- Orbit logo at the top: https://assets.orbit.dev/img/orbit-logo.png (show it 126px wide).
- Hero image, full content width: https://assets.orbit.dev/img/orbit-app.png (1200×700 file).
- Heading: "Orbit 2.0 is here"
- Paragraph: "Everything you need to ship every surface from one codebase."
- Three feature columns, side by side on desktop and stacked on phones:
  - "Live previews": "See every change as you type."
  - "Typed templates": "Catch mistakes before you send."
  - "One-click deploys": "Ship to production in seconds."
- Button "Try Orbit 2.0" linking to https://orbit.dev/2, background #6d5efc, white text.
- Footer with the text "You're receiving this because you signed up for Orbit." and an "Unsubscribe" link to https://orbit.dev/unsubscribe.
- Light grey page background (#f1f2f6), white 600px content card.
